# Go vulnerabilities govulncheck reports as reachable that OnScreen has
# reviewed and either is not exposed to or mitigates in its own code.
# CI (the govulncheck job) fails only on reachable advisories NOT listed here.
#
# One advisory per line: the ID, then why it's safe. Remove a line when the
# dependency ships a fix and we've upgraded, or when the reason stops holding.

GO-2026-6911  mark3labs/mcp-go follows MCP-server redirects with credentials, but only with its default client. internal/plugin passes its own client whose CheckRedirect refuses every redirect (egress.go; enforced by egress_test.go). No upstream fix yet.
GO-2026-6909  crewjam/saml before v0.6 accepted a foreign-namespace NameID and crashed on an assertion without Subject. v0.6.3 (in go.mod) decodes NameID by namespace and checks for a missing Subject, but the advisory still lists no fixed version, so govulncheck reports it. internal/api/v1/auth_saml_guard.go still refuses those shapes before the library parses them; TestSAMLGuard_UpstreamRejectsForeignNameID checks the library keeps refusing the NameID. Remove this line when the advisory records a fixed version.
